ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
ESV.2: “Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When any man has a discharge from his body,  his discharge is unclean.
ESV.3: And this is the law of his uncleanness for a discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body is blocked up by his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
ESV.4: Every bed on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and everything on which he sits shall be unclean.
ESV.5: And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.6: And whoever sits on anything on which the one with the discharge has sat shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.7: And whoever touches the body of the one with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.8: And if the one with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.9: And any saddle on which the one with the discharge rides shall be unclean.
ESV.10: And whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. And whoever carries such things shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.11: Anyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.12: And an earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
ESV.13: “And when the one with a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes. And he shall bathe his body in fresh water and shall be clean.
ESV.14: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons and come before the LORD to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
ESV.15: And the priest shall use them, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.
ESV.16: “If a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.17: And every garment and every skin on which the semen comes shall be washed with water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.18: If a man lies with a woman and has an emission of semen, both of them shall bathe themselves in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.19: “When a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her body is blood, she shall be in her menstrual impurity for seven days, and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
ESV.20: And everything on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean. Everything also on which she sits shall be unclean.
ESV.21: And whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.22: And whoever touches anything on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.23: Whether it is the bed or anything on which she sits, when he touches it he shall be unclean until the evening.
ESV.24: And if any man lies with her and her menstrual impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
ESV.25: “If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her impurity, all the days of the discharge she shall continue in uncleanness. As in the days of her impurity, she shall be unclean.
ESV.26: Every bed on which she lies, all the days of her discharge, shall be to her as the bed of her impurity. And everything on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.
ESV.27: And whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
ESV.28: But if she is cleansed of her discharge, she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
ESV.29: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
ESV.30: And the priest shall use one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.
ESV.31: “Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst.”
ESV.32: This is the law for him who has a discharge and for him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby;
ESV.33: also for her who is unwell with her menstrual impurity, that is, for anyone, male or female, who has a discharge, and for the man who lies with a woman who is unclean.

NKJV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
NKJV.2: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
NKJV.3: And this shall be his uncleanness in regard to his discharge—whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body is stopped up by his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
NKJV.4: Every bed is unclean on which he who has the discharge lies, and everything on which he sits shall be unclean.
NKJV.5: And whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.6: He who sits on anything on which he who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.7: And he who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.8: If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.9: Any saddle on which he who has the discharge rides shall be unclean.
NKJV.10: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening. He who carries any of those things shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.11: And whomever the one who has the discharge touches, and has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.12: The vessel of earth that he who has the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
NKJV.13: ‘And when he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe his body in running water; then he shall be clean.
NKJV.14: On the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and give them to the priest.
NKJV.15: Then the priest shall offer them, the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD because of his discharge.
NKJV.16: ‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall wash all his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.17: And any garment and any leather on which there is semen, it shall be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.18: Also, when a woman lies with a man, and there is an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.19: ‘If a woman has a discharge, and the discharge from her body is blood, she shall be set apart seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
NKJV.20: Everything that she lies on during her impurity shall be unclean; also everything that she sits on shall be unclean.
NKJV.21: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.22: And whoever touches anything that she sat on shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.23: If anything is on her bed or on anything on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
NKJV.24: And if any man lies with her at all, so that her impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
NKJV.25: ‘If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, other than at the time of her customary impurity, or if it runs beyond her usual time of impurity, all the days of her unclean discharge shall be as the days of her customary impurity. She shall be unclean.
NKJV.26: Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her impurity; and whatever she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
NKJV.27: Whoever touches those things shall be unclean; he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NKJV.28: ‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
NKJV.29: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.30: Then the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the discharge of her uncleanness.
NKJV.31: ‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness when they defile My tabernacle that is among them.
NKJV.32: This is the law for one who has a discharge, and for him who emits semen and is unclean thereby,
NKJV.33: and for her who is indisposed because of her customary impurity, and for one who has a discharge, either man or woman, and for him who lies with her who is unclean.’ ”

NASB.1: The LORD also spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
NASB.2: 'Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, 'When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
NASB.3: 'This, moreover, shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: it is his uncleanness whether his body allows its discharge to flow or whether his body obstructs its discharge.
NASB.4: 'Every bed on which the person with the discharge lies becomes unclean, and everything on which he sits becomes unclean.
NASB.5: 'Anyone, moreover, who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening;
NASB.6: and whoever sits on the thing on which the man with the discharge has been sitting, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.7: 'Also whoever touches the person with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.8: 'Or if the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, he too shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.9: 'Every saddle on which the person with the discharge rides becomes unclean.
NASB.10: 'Whoever then touches any of the things which were under him shall be unclean until evening, and he who carries them shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.11: 'Likewise, whomever the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.12: 'However, an earthenware vessel which the person with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.
NASB.13: 'Now when the man with the discharge becomes cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count off for himself seven days for his cleansing; he shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in running water and will become clean.
NASB.14: 'Then on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the doorway of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest;
NASB.15: and the priest shall offer them, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD because of his discharge.
NASB.16: 'Now if a man has a seminal emission, he shall bathe all his body in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.17: 'As for any garment or any leather on which there is seminal emission, it shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.18: 'If a man lies with a woman [so that] there is a seminal emission, they shall both bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.19: 'When a woman has a discharge, [if] her discharge in her body is blood, she shall continue in her menstrual impurity for seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
NASB.20: 'Everything also on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
NASB.21: 'Anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.22: 'Whoever touches any thing on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.23: 'Whether it be on the bed or on the thing on which she is sitting, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
NASB.24: 'If a man actually lies with her so that her menstrual impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
NASB.25: 'Now if a woman has a discharge of her blood many days, not at the period of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond that period, all the days of her impure discharge she shall continue as though in her menstrual impurity; she is unclean.
NASB.26: 'Any bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her like her bed at menstruation; and every thing on which she sits shall be unclean, like her uncleanness at that time.
NASB.27: 'Likewise, whoever touches them shall be unclean and shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NASB.28: 'When she becomes clean from her discharge, she shall count off for herself seven days; and afterward she will be clean.
NASB.29: 'Then on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them in to the priest, to the doorway of the tent of meeting.
NASB.30: 'The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on her behalf before the LORD because of her impure discharge.'
NASB.31: 'Thus you shall keep the sons of Israel separated from their uncleanness, so that they will not die in their uncleanness by their defiling My tabernacle that is among them.'
NASB.32: This is the law for the one with a discharge, and for the man who has a seminal emission so that he is unclean by it,
NASB.33: and for the woman who is ill because of menstrual impurity, and for the one who has a discharge, whether a male or a female, or a man who lies with an unclean woman.

NLT.1: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
NLT.2: “Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. “Any man who has a bodily discharge is ceremonially unclean.
NLT.3: This defilement is caused by his discharge, whether the discharge continues or stops. In either case the man is unclean.
NLT.4: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies and anything on which he sits will be ceremonially unclean.
NLT.5: So if you touch the man’s bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.6: If you sit where the man with the discharge has sat, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.7: If you touch the man with the discharge, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.8: If the man spits on you, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.9: Any saddle blanket on which the man rides will be ceremonially unclean.
NLT.10: If you touch anything that was under the man, you will be unclean until evening. You must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.11: If the man touches you without first rinsing his hands, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
NLT.12: Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil he touches must be rinsed with water.

CSB17.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron:
CSB17.2: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any man has a discharge <sup>ⓚ</sup> from his member, he is unclean.
CSB17.3: This is uncleanness of his discharge: Whether his member secretes the discharge or retains it, he is unclean. All the days that his member secretes or retains anything because of his discharge, <sup>[1]</sup> he is unclean.
CSB17.4: Any bed the man with the discharge lies on will be unclean, and any furniture he sits on will be unclean.
CSB17.5: Anyone who touches his bed is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.6: Whoever sits on furniture that the man with the discharge was sitting on is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.7: Whoever touches the body <sup>[2]</sup> of the man with a discharge is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.8: If the man with the discharge spits on anyone who is clean, he is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.9: Any saddle the man with the discharge rides on will be unclean. <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.10: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.11: If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands in water, <sup>ⓜ</sup> the person who was touched is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.12: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken, while any wooden utensil is to be rinsed with water. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.13: “When the man with the discharge has been cured of it, he is to count seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe his body in fresh water; he will be clean.
CSB17.14: He must take two turtledoves or two young pigeons on the eighth day, come before the LORD at the entrance to the tent of meeting, and give them to the priest.
CSB17.15: The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. <sup>ⓐ</sup> In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD because of his discharge.
CSB17.16: “When a man has an emission of semen, <sup>ⓑ</sup> he is to bathe himself completely with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.17: Any clothing or leather on which there is an emission of semen is to be washed with water, and it will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.18: If a man sleeps with a woman and has an emission of semen, both of them are to bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.19: “When a woman has a discharge, and it consists of blood from her body, she will be unclean because of her menstruation <sup>ⓓ</sup> for seven days. Everyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
CSB17.20: Anything she lies on during her menstruation will become unclean, and anything she sits on will become unclean.
CSB17.21: Everyone who touches her bed is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.22: Everyone who touches any furniture she was sitting on is to wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.23: If discharge is on the bed or the furniture she was sitting on, when he touches it he will be unclean until evening.
CSB17.24: If a man sleeps with her, and blood from her menstruation gets on him, he will be unclean for seven days, and every bed he lies on will become unclean. <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.25: “When a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days, though it is not the time of her menstruation, or if she has a discharge beyond her period, she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge, as she is during the days of her menstruation.
CSB17.26: Any bed she lies on during the days of her discharge will be like her bed during menstrual impurity; any furniture she sits on will be unclean as in her menstrual period.
CSB17.27: Everyone who touches them will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will remain unclean until evening.
CSB17.28: When she is cured of her discharge, she is to count seven days, and after that she will be clean. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.29: On the eighth day she must take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
CSB17.30: The priest is to sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD because of her unclean discharge.
CSB17.31: “You must keep the Israelites from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling my tabernacle <sup>ⓖ</sup> that is among them.
CSB17.32: This is the law for someone with a discharge: a man who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean by it;
CSB17.33: a woman who is in her menstrual period; anyone who has a discharge, whether male or female; and a man who sleeps with a woman who is unclean.”

AMP.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
AMP.2: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, 'When any man has a bodily discharge, his discharge is unclean.
AMP.3: This shall be [the law concerning] his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body allows its discharge to flow or obstructs its flow; it is uncleanness in him.
AMP.4: Every bed on which the one who has the discharge lies becomes unclean, and everything on which he sits becomes unclean.
AMP.5: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening;
AMP.6: and whoever sits on anything on which the man with the discharge has been sitting shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.7: Also whoever touches the man with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.8: And if he who has the discharge spits on one who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.9: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides becomes unclean.
AMP.10: Whoever touches anything that has been under him shall be unclean until evening; and whoever carries those things shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.11: Whomever the one with the discharge touches without rinsing his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.12: An earthenware container that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden container shall be rinsed in water.
AMP.13: 'When the man with the discharge becomes cleansed from his discharge, he shall count off seven days for his purification; he shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in running water and will become clean.
AMP.14: On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and come before the LORD to the doorway of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest;
AMP.15: and the priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.
AMP.16: 'Now if any man has a seminal emission, he shall wash all his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.17: Every garment and every leather on which there is semen shall be washed with water, and shall be unclean until evening.
AMP.18: If a man lies with a woman so that there is a seminal emission, they shall both bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
AMP.19: 'When a woman has a discharge, if her bodily discharge is blood, she shall continue in her menstrual impurity for seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
AMP.20: Everything on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean; and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
AMP.21: Anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.22: Whoever touches anything on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.23: And if it is on her bed or on the thing on which she is sitting, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
AMP.24: If a man actually lies with her so that her menstrual impurity is on him, he shall be unclean for seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
AMP.25: 'Now if a woman has a flow of blood for many days, not during the time of her menstruation, or if she has a discharge beyond that period, as long as the impure discharge continues she shall be as she is in the days of her [normal] menstrual impurity; she is unclean.
AMP.26: Every bed on which she lies during the time of her discharge shall be to her like the bed of her menstrual impurity, and whatever she sits on shall be unclean, like the uncleanness of her monthly period.
AMP.27: And whoever touches those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
AMP.28: When she is cleansed from her discharge, then she shall count off for herself seven days, and after that she will be clean.
AMP.29: Then on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the doorway of the Tent of Meeting;
AMP.30: and the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; and he shall make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.'
AMP.31: "Thus you shall separate the Israelites from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by their defiling My tabernacle that is among them."
AMP.32: This is the law for the one who has a discharge and for the one who has a seminal emission, so that he is unclean by it;
AMP.33: and for the woman who is ill because of her monthly period, and for the one who has a discharge, whether man or woman, or for a man who lies with a woman who is [ceremonially] unclean.

NRSVCE.22: Whoever touches anything upon which she sits shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening;
NRSVCE.23: whether it is the bed or anything upon which she sits, when he touches it he shall be unclean until the evening.
NRSVCE.24: If any man lies with her, and her impurity falls on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
NRSVCE.25: If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her impurity, all the days of the discharge she shall continue in uncleanness; as in the days of her impurity, she shall be unclean.
NRSVCE.26: Every bed on which she lies during all the days of her discharge shall be treated as the bed of her impurity; and everything on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her impurity.
NRSVCE.27: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.
NRSVCE.28: If she is cleansed of her discharge, she shall count seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
NRSVCE.29: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
NRSVCE.30: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement on her behalf before the LORD for her unclean discharge.
NRSVCE.31: Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst.
NRSVCE.32: This is the ritual for those who have a discharge: for him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby,
NRSVCE.33: for her who is in the infirmity of her period, for anyone, male or female, who has a discharge, and for the man who lies with a woman who is unclean.

NET.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron:
NET.2: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
NET.3: Now this is his uncleanness in regard to his discharge — whether his body secretes his discharge or blocks his discharge, he is unclean. All the days that his body has a discharge or his body blocks his discharge, this is his uncleanness.
NET.4: “‘Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and any furniture he sits on will be unclean.
NET.5: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.6: The one who sits on the furniture the man with a discharge sits on must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.7: The one who touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.8: If the man with a discharge spits on a person who is ceremonially clean, that person must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.9: Any means of riding the man with a discharge rides on will be unclean.
NET.10: Anyone who touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and the one who carries those items must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.11: Anyone whom the man with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.12: A clay vessel which the man with the discharge touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil must be rinsed in water.
NET.13: “‘When the man with the discharge becomes clean from his discharge he is to count off for himself seven days for his purification, and he must wash his clothes, bathe in fresh water, and be clean.
NET.14: Then on the eighth day he is to take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and he is to present himself before the LORD at the entrance of the Meeting Tent and give them to the priest,
NET.15: and the priest is to make one of them a sin offering and the other a burnt offering. So the priest is to make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.
NET.16: “‘When a man has a seminal emission, he must bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until evening,
NET.17: and he must wash in water any clothing or leather that has semen on it, and it will be unclean until evening.
NET.18: When a man has sexual intercourse with a woman and there is a seminal emission, they must bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
NET.19: “‘When a woman has a discharge and her discharge is blood from her body, she is to be in her menstruation seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
NET.20: Anything she lies on during her menstruation will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.
NET.21: Anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.22: Anyone who touches any furniture she sits on must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.23: If there is something on the bed or on the furniture she sits on, when he touches it he will be unclean until evening,
NET.24: and if a man actually has sexual intercourse with her so that her menstrual impurity touches him, then he will be unclean seven days and any bed he lies on will be unclean.
NET.25: “‘When a woman’s discharge of blood flows many days not at the time of her menstruation, or if it flows beyond the time of her menstruation, all the days of her discharge of impurity will be like the days of her menstruation — she is unclean.
NET.26: Any bed she lies on all the days of her discharge will be to her like the bed of her menstruation, any furniture she sits on will be unclean like the impurity of her menstruation,
NET.27: and anyone who touches them will be unclean, and he must wash his clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
NET.28: “‘If she becomes clean from her discharge, then she is to count off for herself seven days, and afterward she will be clean.
NET.29: Then on the eighth day she must take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and she must bring them to the priest at the entrance of the Meeting Tent,
NET.30: and the priest is to make one a sin offering and the other a burnt offering. So the priest is to make atonement for her before the LORD from her discharge of impurity.
NET.31: “‘Thus you are to set the Israelites apart from their impurity so that they do not die in their impurity by defiling my tabernacle which is in their midst.
NET.32: This is the law of the one with a discharge: the one who has a seminal emission and becomes unclean by it,
NET.33: the one who is sick in her menstruation, the one with a discharge, whether male or female, and a man who has sexual intercourse with an unclean woman.’”
